responsibility: Defines the TILE-Gx backend’s register, immediate, symbolic, memory, and vector-constant operand constraints used by reload, recog, and instruction selection. It maps named single-register classes such as R00-R10 to specific hard registers and character constraints such as I/J/K/M/T/U/W/Y/Z* to target-specific constant ranges, bitfield masks, symbolic UNSPEC forms, and non-autoincrement memory operands, providing the constraint vocabulary referenced throughout the machine description.
